subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted gateway run cannot be recovered conclusively, should `openclaw agent` fail closed by default with an opt-in rerun, or preserve the current automatic isolated fallback?
rationale: This is a user-visible compatibility choice between avoiding duplicate effects and preserving automatic CLI completion; neither the PR body nor its changed documentation currently establishes one agreed contract.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed recovery
options.body: Keep the proposed no-rerun default and make the explicit rerun escape hatch, CLI output, tests, and docs agree.

options.title: Preserve automatic fallback
options.body: Retain the current fresh-session embedded fallback after recovery exhaustion and describe replay as a best-effort first stage.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Use different defaults for `--deliver` and interactive output only if owners explicitly want separate contracts.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed no-rerun default and make the explicit rerun escape hatch, CLI output, tests, and docs agree.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged adjacent fallback behavior is the most direct current-main ownership signal in the supplied history.
